description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of August 2016 being 113.4, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of September, 2016 will be Rs. 638.53
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific trades, which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance, making it a public service administrative matter rather than a government structural/personnel change or any other specialized category.
